title: store.append acquires a second pool connection while holding the first, exhausting the pool (TC-EXP-301-08)
symptom: TC-EXP-301-08 fails with PoolError.ExhaustedPool raised at src/db/pool.zig:783 (`if (self.idle_count == 0) return PoolError.ExhaustedPool`), reached from src/event_store/store.zig:428 (`const dup_conn = self.pool.acquire() catch return StoreError.PoolExhausted;`), called from the test's second `store.append(allocator, params)` at tests/integration/effects_subsystem_test.zig:886.
root_cause_analysis: On the duplicate-idempotency-key path, store.append acquires a SECOND connection from the pool to look up the original event while its first connection is still held for the in-flight transaction. Under parallel test execution the pool has no idle connection left to hand out, so the nested acquire fails. This is a connection-discipline defect in production code, not a test-fixture problem: any caller that appends a duplicate event while the pool is saturated hits it. It is self-deadlock-shaped — the same call path holds and then demands a second lease from a finite pool.
impact: 1 of the 3 remaining effects_subsystem_test failures. In production this surfaces as spurious StoreError.PoolExhausted on idempotent re-appends under load, i.e. exactly when a retry storm is in progress and dedup matters most.
acceptance_criteria: The duplicate-lookup path no longer acquires a second pool connection while the first is held — reuse the connection already in hand, or perform the lookup after releasing it
TC-EXP-301-08 passes under a loaded parallel run
A regression test covers append-of-duplicate while the pool has zero idle connections
No other store.zig path nests pool.acquire() inside a held lease
related: ISS-0158 / GH #479 - the run that isolated this as a distinct cause
notes: Filed per CLAUDE.md 'No Issue Left Local-Only' and the 'filed and forwarded, not fixed here' scope boundary. Unrelated to the SERVICE_TASK effect-emission ownership defects fixed under ISS-0158.
